collection.title: Audi A6/S6/RS6 Avant 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A6 Avant 2024 Onwards which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Please Note: These wiper blades are not suitable for models with built in Washer Jets.
